title: DFlash 2: keep drafting parallel
org: Inco AI, with the original DFlash group
gist: A block drafter that keeps several candidates per position and uses a tiny selector to pick one coherent path through them. Its published tables show speed-up against plain decoding at three load levels and five kinds of task.
changes: The cleanest public numbers on what happens to speculation under load: a threefold gain for a single request falls to almost nothing at 32 concurrent, and rival drafters fall below break-even.
caveats: Self-reported on one model and one GPU; training data is not disclosed and there is no paper. The tables by load are on the model card, not in the post. The rival DSpark drafter is a community build, which scored below the model's own head. The company offers to build drafters for customers' tuned models, which implies each tuned model needs its own.

numbers.metric: Speed-up, one request at a time

numbers.value: 0.74 to 1.13x, below break-even on four of five tasks

bears_on.note: The same drafter is worth 3x or nothing depending on load and on the kind of text.
A drafter is tied to one exact model. Tune the model and the drafter has to be rebuilt.
